newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Four Seas Travel says in share sale talks.
newsitem.headline: Four Seas Travel says in share sale talks.

text.p: Four Seas Travel International Ltd said on Tuesday its controlling shareholder and managing director Leung Hoi is in talks to sell a stake to China North Industries Corp (CNIC).
In a statement, the travel services provider said Leung "has been approached by CNIC regarding a proposal involving the possible acquisition by CNIC of shares in the company".
"Nevertheless, preliminary discussions have been held with CNIC to explore business opportunities between CNIC and the company," it said.
Four Seas Travel said no agreement had been reached and no legally binding agreement had been entered into.
Gaware Holdings Ltd, owned by Leung and Four Seas Travel's chairman Leung Yeung Lai Ming, held 63.2 percent of the company as on January 22.
Shares of Four Seas Travel were up HK$0.12 or 6.67 percent to HK$1.92 in late trade on Tuesday.
Four Seas Travel sells airline tickets and other travel-related services and engages in property investment.
